definition.simple: Three lines around price: a moving average in the middle, and bands above and below that widen when price has been jumpy and narrow when it has been calm.
definition.balanced: With the common (20, 2) settings, the middle line is a 20-period simple moving average. The bands sit 2 standard deviations of the last 20 closes above and below it. A touch of a band is not a signal by itself. In a strong trend price can ride along one band for many candles. Narrow bands show that recent movement was small, not which way the next move will go.

example: Middle 1.10000 and standard deviation 0.00150: upper band 1.10300, lower band 1.09700.
